content: In evaluation we consider two settings, namely SST-2 and SST-5, the two differing only in their level of granularity with regard to labels. In SST-2, data samples annotated with `neutral' are ignored from training and evaluation. The two positive labels (very positive, positive) are considered as the same label, and similarly for the two negative labels. As a result 98,794/872/1,821 data samples are used in training/validation/test, and the task is considered as a binary classification problem. In SST-5, data are used as-is and thus the task is a 5-class classification problem. All 318,582/1,101/2,210 data samples for training/validation/test are used in the SST-5 setting.
